import re

def parse_song_line(line):
    # Format: "- Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
    m = re.match(r'^- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT TODO$', line)
    if m:
        title = m.group(1).strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in m.group(2).split(',')]
        return title, artists
    return None, None
